name: legendkeeper
description: Unofficial worldbuilding companion for LegendKeeper: turn scanned session notes into pages, NPCs and timeline events in your world's voice, answer questions from your wiki, and check writing for continuity.

api_key.title: LegendKeeper API key
api_key.description: In LegendKeeper: Project Settings → Developers → API Keys. Use an Admin key to create top-level pages. Requires a paid LegendKeeper plan.
